books.title: The 48 Laws of Power
books.author: Robert Greene
books.blurb: Robert Greene's 48 laws, each with its own illustrated scene. Jump to any law from the board, then open it for the idea, the story the book tells, how it is meant to work, when it reverses and what it costs.

books.title: Animal Farm
books.author: George Orwell
books.blurb: Step through Orwell's ten chapters and watch the farm, and the commandments painted on the barn wall, change. Then meet the characters and the history each one stands for.

books.title: The Art of Seduction
books.author: Robert Greene
books.blurb: Greene's nine seducer characters as a deck of court cards, the eighteen kinds of target, and the twenty-four moves of the process in four phases, each also seen from the receiving end.

books.title: Atomic Habits
books.author: James Clear
books.blurb: The compounding curve, the four-step habit loop and the four laws of behaviour change, with a builder that turns them into one habit of your own and a 30-day tracker.

books.title: How to Talk to Anyone
books.author: Leil Lowndes
books.blurb: Nine stops through a conversation, from the first look across the room to the goodbye. Each one draws the scene and opens Lowndes's techniques into a before-and-after exchange you can try today.

books.title: 12 Rules for Life
books.author: Jordan B. Peterson
books.blurb: Peterson's twelve rules as a wall of cards. Each opens to the idea, how the book argues it, something to try and a common objection, with the themes that run through the whole book underneath.

books.title: Beyond Order
books.author: Jordan B. Peterson
books.blurb: The companion to 12 Rules for Life: twelve more rules, this time warning against too much order. Each card opens to the idea, the book's argument, something to try and a common objection.

books.title: The Four Agreements
books.author: Don Miguel Ruiz
books.blurb: Ruiz's four promises to yourself as a medallion in four quarters. Open an agreement, flip the picture between the old habit and the agreement, and try it on an everyday situation.

books.title: The Subtle Art of Not Giving a F*ck
books.author: Mark Manson
books.blurb: Manson's argument that a good life comes from caring about fewer things and choosing them well. Nine chapters to tap through, plus a budget of five cares to spend on what matters to you.

books.title: Everything Is F*cked
books.author: Mark Manson
books.blurb: The follow-up, a book about hope: why people feel hopeless when life has never been materially better. Nine chapters to tap through and a blue-dot slider that shows how problems get redefined as they become rare.

books.title: Maps of Meaning
books.author: Jordan B. Peterson
books.blurb: Peterson's dense first book made walkable: why people need stories, the map of the known and the unknown, the cast of mythic characters, and what happens when a story breaks. With chapters, vocabulary and objections.
books.source: Maps of Meaning_ an illustrated guide.html

books.title: The Art of Thinking Clearly
books.author: Rolf Dobelli
books.blurb: Dobelli's 99 thinking errors sorted into seven families, each with a plain definition, an everyday example and one thing to do about it. Includes a test-yourself round, his method and the objections.
books.source: The Art of Thinking Clearly_ 99 thinking errors.html

books.title: The Manipulation Ladder
books.author: The Diary Of A CEO
books.blurb: The five stages an operative uses to take over a target, as described on The Diary Of A CEO, climbed one rung at a time: what each looks like, why it works, the red flags and your counter-move, with a spot-the-stage quiz.
